exposure: previous history of adverse birth outcome
cohort: 538 mothers with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) who gave birth in specialized hospitals in the Amhara Region, Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of adverse birth outcomes among mothers with PROM was 33.1%, with rural residency, history of urinary tract infection, anemia, previous adverse birth outcome, and interpregnancy interval less than two years being positively associated factors.
